{{nutritionsummary|1 buckeye (33 g)|25|172|88|9.8 g|2.6 g|1 mg|11 mg|18.4 g|0.5 g|18.2 g|2.6 g|2%|1%|3%|2%}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Confections|Confections]]

'''Buckeyes''' are an easy snack named from their resemblance to the nut of the Buckeye tree.

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (320 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]/11 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:butter|melted butter]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:vanilla|vanilla]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] ({{convert|375|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
* 1 small bag ({{convert|100|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Chocolate chip|semi-sweet chocolate chips]]
* 25 [[Cookbook:Skewer|toothpicks]]

==Procedure==
#Mix peanut butter, melted butter, vanilla, and powdered sugar in a bowl.
#Form the mixture into 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] balls.
#Place a toothpick into each ball.
#Refrigerate or freeze for an hour.
#Melt the semi-sweet chocolate chips in a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]].
#Dip the balls in the melted chocolate, leaving a small exposed circle at the top.
#Place on wax paper and remove toothpick.
#Refrigerate or freeze.
